## What were you trying to learn?

Name the module or foundation command and expected result.

## Reproduction

List the commands and synthetic inputs needed to reproduce the failure.

## What happened?

Paste the relevant error after removing account IDs, tokens, API keys, email addresses and private inputs. Do not attach `.env`.

## Environment

Include operating system, Python/uv versions, model provider, package versions from `scripts/check_env.py`, and whether this was mock, local or live mode.

## Checks already tried

Describe troubleshooting steps and whether the offline tests pass.
